top_signals.title: China’s AI Trade Favors Global Winners Over Local Champions
top_signals.summary: China’s push for global AI supremacy is increasingly benefiting companies that supply the rest of the world, with investors favoring such stocks as fierce competition hurts their domestically focused peers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump administration is examining whether a diesel export ban is feasible, Treasury Secretary says
top_signals.summary: Republican lawmakers have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: JD Sports bemoans ‘tough trading’ as US sales slip
top_signals.summary: JD Sports has seen revenue and profit slip so far this year, as weak consumer confidence in its key US market drives a “tough trading environment”.  Régis Schultz, chief executive of the so-called ‘King of Trainers’, said on Wednesday that he is “encouraged” by the progress towards his growth plan while admitting that cost-of-living pressures [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Italian Navy plots race of two local machines: an F-35B against a Ferrari
top_signals.summary: The Italian Navy wants to find out if one of its F-35B fighter jets can outrace a Ferrari SF90 on the ground.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Royal Navy successfully launches US Mk 48 torpedo from uncrewed submersible
top_signals.summary: Last week, the Royal Navy successfully launched a U.S.-made Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo from a British Excalibur uncrewed underwater vehicle.
